# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM python:3.12-slim

RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git redis-server \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

WORKDIR /app
RUN git clone --depth 1 --filter=blob:none --sparse https://github.com/docker/awesome-compose.git /tmp/awesome-compose \
    && cd /tmp/awesome-compose \
    && git sparse-checkout set flask-redis \
    && cp -r flask-redis/. /app/ \
    && rm -rf /tmp/awesome-compose

name: postgres-pgadmin
description: Docker's official postgresql-pgadmin example (docker/awesome-compose) — a PostgreSQL database with a pgAdmin web UI, so classmates can browse and query a shared database.
tags: [database, postgres, pgadmin, web]

deploy:
  units:
    - type: container
      build: .
      expose: http
      port: 80
      mounts:
        - source: /home/bench-20260919-2334/postgres-pgadmin-data
          target: /data
          mode: rw
      secrets: [POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, POSTGRES_DB, PGADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL, PGADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD]
      limits: { cpu: "1", memory: "512Mi" }

# syntax=docker/dockerfile:1
FROM python:3.12-slim

RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
        postgresql postgresql-contrib \
        gcc libpq-dev python3-dev libffi-dev libssl-dev build-essential \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --root-user-action=ignore pgadmin4

COPY entrypoint.sh /entrypoint.sh
RUN chmod +x /entrypoint.sh

EXPOSE 80
CMD ["/entrypoint.sh"]

#!/bin/sh
set -e

PG_BIN=/usr/lib/postgresql/$(ls /usr/lib/postgresql)/bin
export PATH="$PG_BIN:$PATH"

PGDATA=/data/postgres
export PGDATA

if [ ! -s "$PGDATA/PG_VERSION" ]; then
  mkdir -p "$PGDATA"
  chown -R postgres:postgres "$PGDATA"
  echo "$POSTGRES_PASSWORD" > /tmp/pwfile
  chown postgres:postgres /tmp/pwfile
  su postgres -c "initdb -D '$PGDATA' --username='$POSTGRES_USER' --pwfile=/tmp/pwfile"
  rm -f /tmp/pwfile
fi
chown -R postgres:postgres "$PGDATA"

su postgres -c "pg_ctl -D '$PGDATA' -l /data/postgres.log -o '-c listen_addresses=*' start"

until su postgres -c "pg_isready -q"; do sleep 1; done

su postgres -c "createdb -U '$POSTGRES_USER' '$POSTGRES_DB'" 2>/dev/null || true

mkdir -p /data/pgadmin

export PGADMIN_SETUP_EMAIL="$PGADMIN_DEFAULT_EMAIL"
export PGADMIN_SETUP_PASSWORD="$PGADMIN_DEFAULT_PASSWORD"

PGADMIN_DIR=/usr/local/lib/python3.12/site-packages/pgadmin4
cd "$PGADMIN_DIR"

cat > config_local.py <<-EOPY
DATA_DIR = '/data/pgadmin'
LOG_FILE = '/data/pgadmin/pgadmin4.log'
DEFAULT_SERVER = '0.0.0.0'
DEFAULT_SERVER_PORT = 80
UPGRADE_CHECK_ENABLED = False
EOPY

python3 setup.py

exec python3 pgAdmin4.py
